profile.headline: Renaissance Man
profile.summary: Software Engineer (Developer, DevOps, Q.A., and Support) with an extensive background in I.T.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enmotus provided hardware and software solutions to enhance performance and reliability of storage devices.
    Software Development:
⦁	Assisted in the development of various programs and libraries in C, C++, C#, and Java, including a Windows system tray tool and a shell extension.
⦁	Created interfaces with the Windows API for storage system analysis and the manipulation of the boot configuration and recovery environment.
⦁	Developed several elaborate NSIS installers for installing virtual storage drivers, updating the recovery environment, dealing with configuration issues, and troubleshooting support issues.
⦁	Created the partner branding kit for the installer, and assisted in designing and implementing the branding kit for Java and C applications.
⦁	Created EFI scripts to load a driver and boot Windows, and to provide configuration and debug menus.
⦁	Responsible for maintaining the Windows and Linux build system including build and packaging scripts for drivers and applications.

    Customer Support and Documentation:
⦁	Provided the bulk of support to end users, and assisted partners in resolving incidents with their users.
⦁	Maintained end-user documentation.  Assisted in creating video content both behind and in front of the camera.

    QA Testing:
⦁	Developed test plans and wrote scripts for automated testing in Linux shell script, Windows batch, PowerShell, AutoHotkey, and Sikuli.
⦁	Worked with developers in replicating and troubleshooting issues.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · NSIS · Java · C# · DevOps

positions.title: I.T. Consultant or Subcontractor
positions.description:
Many companies, including:
A2Z Software • Alliant Foodservice • Chapman University • Cox Communications • Home Loan Funding • The Irvine Company • Newport Beach Police Department • Pacific Life • Tetra Tech • Toyota Financial Services • Ultimate Software • Union Bank • Washington Mutual • Wells Fargo Dealer Services

Experiences include:
• Providing all hardware and software support for large installation bases, including one such of more than 100 users in nine locations throughout California and Nevada.
• Maintaining, deploying, and migrating desktops, laptops, thin clients, tablets, servers, phone and voicemail systems, and storage and networking appliances.
• Lowering cost of hardware, support, and data transmission and provided database centralization by designing and implementing a thin-client workstation model.
• Traveling throughout the United States, supervising teams of field technicians in the installation, configuration, and testing of servers, enterprise computer systems, peripherals, and devices for banking and financial institutions, and providing supplementary on-site support for migration issues and troubleshooting of hardware/software conflicts.
• Programming scripts and batch files to automate the transition of support tickets from and to separate ticketing systems, to automate data transfer and preserve system settings for migration, to configure login environments, and to perform system maintenance.
• Producing instructional materials and videos for users and technicians.  Designing websites and databases.

positions.title: Of Counsel
positions.description:
• Met with clients and provided legal advice
• Made court appearances, prepared briefs and filings, produced contracts, and performed legal research
